Bangladesh Considers Joining Saudi-Pakistan-Turkey Defense Pact

Bangladesh is reportedly considering joining a defense pact involving Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey, described by some as an 'Islamic NATO'. This possibility was conveyed by a top aide to Tarique Rahman, a prominent Bangladeshi political figure. The Indian Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) has reacted to this development. The pact's potential members are Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkey.
